title: KitchenAid KQ908 Glass Surface 11 Pound Capacity Digital Kitchen and Food Scale, Scale for Food Ounces and Grams, Dry and Liquid Ingredients, Black
description:
About this item
MAX CAPACITY: Dry ingredients: 11 LB X 0.1 Oz and 5000 grams x 1 gram Liquid ingredients: 5000 millilitre x 1 millilitre and 176 FL Oz x 0.1 FL Oz
UNIQUE FEATURE: Rotating knob design inspired by KitchenAid countertop electric ovens. Twist to set the units of measurement and push to Tare or power on/off
TARE: Weigh all ingredients into one container by using the Tare feature to zero out weights in-between additions. Also works to zero the weight of any container before adding food
BATTERY: Powered by three (3) AAA batteries, included. Scale can be powered off of will auto shut-off after a 3 minutes of no change inweight on the platform
EASY TO CLEAN: Hand wash only; do not immerse in water or put in dishwasher; for best results, wipe with a damp cloth and dry thoroughly

It took a “minute” to figure out how to work it. I had used another make for several years. BUT after a bit of culture shock…it works PERFECTLY!
In fact…I like it BETTERBuen material, muy bonito, pense que tenia precision de 1mg pero estaba equivocado, la precisión solo llega a gramo, sin embargo lo conservaré.Perfect for weighing packages to go out for shipment. It is spot on according to the post officeNot cheaply made compared to to other ones from Amazon.I purchased the KitchenAid KQ908 Glass Surface 11 Pound Capacity Digital Kitchen and Food Scale to help with bulk meat splitting and also to help with baking. I’ve used it for so much more. This scale is so easy to operate!! It has an LCD screen that’s large enough I can even read it from a distance. The battery that’s in it now is the one that came with it and I use the scale multiple times a week so the battery life I’d say is very good. It’s a very durable scale even having a glass top. I’ve had it tip over (stands on its side when stored) and it still functions perfectly and no cosmetic damage either. You can quickly switch from grams to pounds to ounces, etc with the turn of the dial and a simple press and hold of the dial recalibrates the scale. I truly don’t know how I’ve survived 40+ yrs in the kitchen without a scale before now!! This thing is wonderful and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking to step up their game in the kitchen!Very niceExcellent product, I use all the time for measure it has good battery life and durability is easy to read . You can adjust it to you needs I really like this product. I do recommend itI got this scale to replace an old cruddy one that I picked up at a thrift store. I was initially unsure about whether it was worth it to pay a bit more than some of the cheaper amazon options, but it's very accurate and easy to read and use.

Being able to tap the button to zero out while building my meals is really helpful, and while I primarily use the "grams" measurement, having the other options easily switchable is great for other recipe needs when my wife and I are baking together. It tucks away nicely into a cabinet or looks nice sitting on a counter.Works well, and is very accurate for wet and dry ingredients.Estoy muy conforme con la compra.

Update: the company that makes this is NOT Kitchen Aid. Kitchen Aid just puts their name on it.

It is 'Lifetime Brands'. And it costs more to send the defective item back (at MY expense) and wait 4-6 weeks for a replacement than simply buying a new one. Of course I'm never buying a kitchen aid (Lifetime Brands) one again!

KitchenAid Customer ServiceI have two reasons to not to recommend this scale: it shuts off while you are measuring a small amount of ingredients like baking powder; the battery cover on the back side of the scale is not easy to open at all, also I had to put on gloves to not to hurt my fingers to open the cover. Another problem is the dial on the surface gets in the way in my kitchen drawers.I am so disappointed with this scale. It is not at all accurate, the number on the scale will keep fluctuating even if you are not adding or removing anything to it. When you hit the tare button, it sometimes doesn't go down to 0 and goes to 1 or 2 instead, even if you hit it multiple times. The numbers is on it just keep on changing randomly, it does not reflect that actual weight of what's on the scale. I bought this because I have many good KitchenAid products and wanted a reliable scale, but this isn't it. :(Stopped working after 4 months. Contacted Kitchen Aid and were very unhelpful. Turns out they license out their name brand and it’s not even their product.I have a handful of budget food scales between my house and office. I finally thought to myself, the next one I buy I'll try out a premium one. So i bought this KitchenAid thinking that it would a solid premium scale that would look nice in my kitchen. Well it is, but the auto-off on this scale is ridiculous and basically makes this scale useless for cooking. Prime example, one of the first things i was cooking was flat bread pizza. I held the button to tare the weight of a bowl, added some cheese, a timer went off i opened the oven pulled out the flat bread, went back to the scale and it was off. I turned it back on and 00.00oz stared back at me. Overall this scale it good for quick one off measurement but i wouldn't recommend it to anyone that actually plans to cook with it.Not as accurate/sensitive as other scales and broke stopped giving a readout Feb 5 literally 5 days after the return period. It the worst of the food scales I have bought which is to bad cuz it cost the most and I like my mixer so I thought kitchen aid it should be good but I was wrong save your money but any of the 10 dollar scales they will run circles around this thingProbably the worst product and shipping service I have ever received. Amazon doesn’t even care anymore. Shipped the product with the shipping label on the original box, which is not ok, as it was supposed to be a gift. And the scale is off, not matter what you do. I hate Amazon.Do not buy the black glass top scale version pictured here. The design is inherently flawed and frankly cheap. I think the excellent reviews this product has are mixed with a different product as those scales look entirely different.

There is one major flaw that makes it unusable. The sensors are built into the "feet" of the scale similar to a bathroom scale. This makes it so that when you press the knob to tare, you press the entire scale down causing the weight to fluctuate, making the tare feature useless! It's impossible to have an accurate tare when you need to press on the weighing surface to tare it!

I hope this saves somebody the time and disappointment.I originally gave this product 5 stars...

It's now been just after the return window has closed and the scale no longer works properly. The weight reading constantly fluctuates even if all you do it touch what's being weighed. Sometimes it will go into negative weight although nothing has been removed.

This is with normal kitchen use for things like flour and sugar in quantities well below the scales max weight threshold. It has never been dropped or mishandled.

I'm very disappointed in this scale especially for the price.I have been using this for baking with no issues. Today I spilled some liquid over the top by accident. I wiped it up immediately, but it was too late. Completely dead. I didn't expect waterproof, but I also didn't expect it to be wrecked by a little spill.
